```kelivo-ui
ui 1 catalog "kelivo.native/1"
root = Column(children=[note,aInput,chart,table], gap="medium")
$a: number = 1
let points = @sample(x => @sqrt(x - $a), -2, 2, 9)
note = Callout(title="合成数学示例", text="y = √(x − a)；拖动滑块后图表与表格在本地更新。定义域外的结果保留为 null 缺口，不填零。", tone="info")
aInput = Slider(label="参数 a", bind=$a, min=-2, max=2, step=0.1)
chart = Chart(kind="line", data=points, x="x", y=["y"], title="合成数学示例：y = √(x − a)", unit="u", xLabel="x", yLabel="y")
table = DataTable(data=points, rowKey="x", columns=[{"key":"x","label":"x","digits":1},{"key":"y","label":"y","digits":3}], pageSize=10, filterable=true, sortable=true)
```
